name: open-saas
description: A 100% free modern JS SaaS boilerplate (React, NodeJS, Prisma). Full-featured: Auth (email, google, github, slack, MS), Email sending, Background jobs, Landing page, Payments (Stripe, Polar.sh), Shadcn UI, S3 file upload. AI-ready with tailored AGENTS.md, skills, and Claude Code plugin. One cmd deploy. Powered by Wasp full-stack framework.

latest_release.name: OpenSaaS for Wasp 0.26
latest_release.body:
Notable changes since Wasp 0.25:

- Added [Paddle](https://www.paddle.com/) as a payment provider (@heymcgovern, @jedpattersonpaddle) ([#714](https://github.com/wasp-lang/open-saas/pull/714))
- Fixed a bug where we'd add credit twice if the payment webhooks delivered the same event again ([#732](https://github.com/wasp-lang/open-saas/pull/732))
- Fixed bugs on the demo app's checking of credits before calling OpenAI ([#738](https://github.com/wasp-lang/open-saas/pull/738))
- The [OpenSaaS docs](https://docs.opensaas.sh/) are now versioned, so docs for older Wasp versions are still available from the version dropdown ([#713](https://github.com/wasp-lang/open-saas/pull/713))
- Plus all the [new Wasp 0.26 features](https://github.com/wasp-lang/wasp/releases/tag/v0.26.0)!
- Updated for [Wasp 0.26.1](https://github.com/wasp-lang/wasp/releases/tag/v0.26.1), which requires Node.js 24.22.1 for the October 2026 Node.js security fixes ([#758](https://github.com/wasp-lang/open-saas/pull/758))
- Fixed AI schedule generation after GPT-3.5 Turbo was retired by switching to GPT-6 Luna ([#760](https://github.com/wasp-lang/open-saas/pull/760))
